# JobHackAI

> JobHackAI is an AI interview prep platform for job seekers. The core product is a realistic voice mock interview: you talk to an AI interviewer about your target role, then get feedback on your answers. The free session includes a feedback preview; paid plans include the full report and transcript. The prep tools (interview question generator, resume feedback and rewrite, cover letter generator) are free with a signup.

JobHackAI is built for active job seekers who have interviews coming up and want to practice out loud before the real thing. It works in the browser on desktop and mobile. No app install.

## What you can do

- Voice Mock Interview: a realistic spoken interview tailored to your target role and job description, with feedback on your answers. Every account gets one lifetime free voice interview with a feedback preview. Paid plans unlock the full report and transcript and further practice.
- Interview Questions: free generator for role specific interview questions with sample answers.
- Resume Feedback and Rewrite: free ATS style scoring, detailed feedback, and AI rewriting of your resume.
- Cover Letter Generator: free tailored cover letters from your resume and a job description.
- Typed Mock Interview: free practice answering questions in writing with AI scoring.

## Pricing

- Free: all prep tools plus one lifetime voice mock interview with a feedback preview (signup required).
- Weekly Pass: 17 USD per week, up to 60 voice interviews per calendar month (UTC) while subscribed. Cancel anytime.
- Monthly: 34 USD per month, up to 60 voice interviews per calendar month (UTC) while subscribed.
- Interview Pack: 39 USD one time, 5 voice interview sessions, valid 90 days.
